annotations.text:
Interview Coach — UI design

Tokens lifted verbatim from web/styles.css, so the mock and the shipped app cannot drift. IBM Plex Sans + Plex Mono; anything in mono is a measured quantity or a machine id.

Pushed past what ships today:
· the turn ribbon — every turn as one bar, notched where a barge-in landed
· sparklines against the 800 ms budget line
· backchannel marks in the transcript gutter
· tool calls typeset as system chrome, not a bubble
· a real hero on the pre-call screen

The state language is the design. Only three objects react to voice state — the waveline, the pill, and the call button's left edge. Every surface and number stays colour-locked so the page is readable while it changes.
